paragraphs: Laurens Vanthoor won the 2024 World Endurance Championship Hypercar title alongside Kévin Estre and André Lotterer, as a Porsche factory driver.
The elder brother of BMW factory driver Dries Vanthoor, the Belgian enters the Nürburgring 24 Hours with Lionspeed GP.

Raffaele Marciello won the 2013 European Formula 3 championship as a Ferrari Academy prospect and served as Sauber's Formula 1 reserve, then rebuilt himself into one of GT racing's leading works drivers, first for Mercedes-AMG and now for BMW, winning the Spa 24 Hours in 2022.
Lello races the Nürburgring 24 Hours with ROWE Racing.
